summary: XPENG INC., a Cayman-incorporated, NYSE- and HKEX-listed Chinese EV manufacturer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026; this is a routine semi-annual earnings disclosure equivalent to a US domestic issuer's quarterly or annual report, not a special situation. Disclosed metrics include deliveries of 165,977 units (down 15.8% year over year), revenues of RMB32.78 billion (down 3.8%), gross margin of 20.6% versus 16.5%, vehicle margin of 12.1%, and a net loss of RMB3.12 billion (wider than RMB1.14 billion a year earlier), with cash position of RMB40.48 billion as of June 30, 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, stake, or premium are stated. No deal terms to arbitrage; watch cash burn, margin trajectory, and July deliveries of 38,027 units.
